design_fidelity.evidence: Matches section M2.3 Autopilot sentence by sentence: dtau cut at tauBurn, tauBurn + tauCoast, tauTotal; accelerate at +a, 0, -a; a phase event per crossing; one tick can hold the whole boost (checkWholeBoostTick; replay tick 2); drag only in the ledger; final piece ends at tauTotal, phi snapped to 0, position to target.pos; arrived carries |x_stepped - d| and |t_stepped - (t0 + galaxyTime)|; leftover at rest. deviations.1_Event_phase_arrived_and_residual_phi: ACCEPTED. The design's events list already names phase (from, to, tau) and arrived (residuals); residual_phi is additive, encoded and decoded symmetrically (protocol_test state fixtures round-trip it with -0.0 and 1e308).
deviations.2_Commitment_el: ACCEPTED. Setting el to the boundary value exactly is what makes phaseAt(trip, el) hit Coasting at tauBurn and Arrived at tauTotal without an ulp of drift; the ship's own tau is the sum of pieces and is allowed to differ by an ulp (probe P1 shows it).
deviations.3_commit_always_rebases: ACCEPTED. Without it a commit along the current heading would measure x - x0 from the last turn, not from the commit; checkPlanFromMovedShip and probes P3/P5 land exactly on the target either way.
deviations.4_tripphase_module_for_ailang_1478: ACCEPTED. ailang#1478 is filed and OPEN (2026-10-01, 'Aliased constructor import never matches; unknown constructor in a pattern is not an error'); the 11-line module is the smallest workaround and every voyage test exercises the 0-3 mapping. Fold the indices back into ShipPhase when the fix lands in a pinned release.
deviations.5_journey_replay_target: ACCEPTED. Part of make test; checks VM == interpreter on the replay and the last line's arrived; CI runs it.
deviations.6_replay_64_inputs: ACCEPTED. AC14 reads the last output line, so the replay must end on the arrival tick (63 x 0.01 = 0.63 >= tauTotal 0.6227); the plan's 'about 70' was an estimate.

verdict: PASS 96/100. All five M2.3b acceptance commands re-run green in a fresh worktree on v0.50.0 with relativity 0.4.0; make test exits 0 locally (76 AILANG tests, 62 physics checks, bridge 0 failures, parity 602/17/13, strict journeyVm/voyageVm VM == interpreter, journey-replay identical) and CI is green on ca26e3d. My independent python voyage from the package formulas reproduces the sim bit for bit: boundary taus 3.418469469655579e-06 / 0.622692452289736 / 0.6226958707592057, arrival residuals x 1.7763568394002505e-15 ly, t 7.993605777301127e-15 yr, phi 4.843059286940843e-11, ledger 6.127642863312837e17 J against tripEnergy 6.127642863312838e17 J (2.1e-16 relative), and every 0.01-yr tick end within 8e-15 of motionAt. Edge probes (a 100-yr single tick, the fallback flip trip, an off-axis target with a turn, ticks exactly on each boundary, Arrived -> replan home -> arrival at the origin, a refused intent mid-flight) behave as designed and are byte-identical on the strict VM. Three of my four mutations were killed; the survivor is equivalent at the tested tolerance. All seven declared deviations are accepted; ailang#1478 is filed and open. Non-blocking: the duplicated boundary expression in phaseEnd, the one-ulp-short `braking` edge, the changelog at landing, and the plan-order note (M2.6a and the R1 checkpoint still ahead).
